name: Hospitals
overview: Scripture reveals that true healing and restoration come from the Lord, who brings health, cure, and peace to His people, as seen in Jeremiah 33:6. The comforting presence of God, described in Psalms 91:1 as abiding under His shadow, provides spiritual refuge beyond physical healing. Proverbs 17:22 highlights the importance of a joyful heart as a medicine, while Luke 4:18 emphasizes Christ’s mission to heal the brokenhearted and set the bruised free, underscoring the gospel’s power to restore both body and soul.
